title.zh: 新加坡民航局（第 67D(1)(g) 与 (h) 条豁免）命令 2025
title.en: Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (Exemption from Section 67D(1)(g) and (h)) Order 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (Exemption from Section 67D(1)(g) and (h)) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 1 April 2025.

3.—(1) Section 67D(1)(g) of the Act does not apply to any person taking any step to enforce any security over any aircraft object that is —
(a)the property of a designated operating entity; or
(b)the trust property of a designated operating entity that is a business trust,
if the enforcement is an exercise by that person of a right or remedy under the IIAE Act.
(2) Section 67D(1)(h) of the Act does not apply to any person taking any step to execute or enforce any judgment or order of court obtained against a designated operating entity, if the execution or enforcement is an exercise by that person of a right or remedy under the IIAE Act.
